glycerol.name: Glycerol (propane-1,2,3-triol)
glycerol.caption: Three —OH groups, one on each carbon — the two ends are primary, the middle carbon is secondary.

phenol.name: Phenol
phenol.caption: The —OH is bonded to a ring carbon itself; on a side chain the same group would make a benzylic alcohol, not a phenol.

salicylic_acid.name: Salicylic acid (2-hydroxybenzoic acid)
salicylic_acid.caption: The new —COOH occupies the carbon next to the —OH, giving 2-hydroxybenzoic acid; the —OH itself is untouched.

anisole.name: Anisole (methoxybenzene)
anisole.caption: One oxygen bridging a methyl group and a ring carbon, so its two C—O bonds are not equivalent.
